postings.description:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a hands-on Accountant to support and progressively take ownership of key accounting processes across sales commissions, revenue, and cost of revenue. This role will apply US GAAP and ASC 606 fundamentals through disciplined month-end execution, reconciliations, audit support, and process improvement. The successful candidate will take ownership of recurring commission accounting activities, support cost of revenue allocations and flux analysis, and provide backup coverage for revenue contract reviews and related accounting conclusions. The role will partner closely with Revenue, Payroll, Sales Operations, Finance Systems, FP&A, Tax, Legal, and external auditors. This is a strong fit for an accountant who can move from source data to accounting conclusion to a complete, well-supported close deliverable—and who is comfortable improving processes in a fast-growing technology company.

You will:

- Own the monthly commission accounting workflow from plan and payout inputs through accruals, capitalization, amortization, expense recognition, actuals, and reconciliation.

- Evaluate which commission costs should be expensed versus capitalized and maintain support for the accounting conclusion.

- Prepare and review commission accruals, commission payable entries, reversals, deferred commission entries, and amortization schedules.

- Reconcile commission payable, deferred commission, commission expense, payroll, contractor bills, and cash-related activity across entities and periods.

- Investigate variances between estimates, accruals, approved payouts, payroll actuals, and final settlement amounts.

- Partner with Sales Operations, Payroll, Accounting Operations, and Finance Systems to resolve plan, eligibility, hierarchy, mapping, and data-quality exceptions.

- Maintain clear documentation of the commission computation, accounting treatment, journal-entry flow, review controls, and open items.

- Support the monthly and quarterly cost of revenue close, including completeness, cut-off, classification, allocations, reconciliations, and flux analysis.

- Prepare allocation workpapers for cloud, LLM, hosting, support, on-call, and other relevant costs using documented drivers; investigate material movements and data gaps.

- Provide backup coverage for revenue accounting and contract reviews during peak periods and planned absences.

- Review commercial arrangements and support ASC 606 conclusions relating to contract modifications, material rights, variable consideration, standalone selling price, and deferred revenue.

- Prepare concise accounting analyses and translate conclusions into journal entries, revenue schedules, reconciliations, and controls.

- Prepare audit-ready schedules, reconciliations, workpapers, and explanations for internal and external audit requests.

- Support walkthroughs, PBC requests, sampling, issue resolution, and remediation tracking.

- Design and execute reviewer controls over commission, revenue, and cost of revenue processes, including completeness, accuracy, cut-off, approval, and evidence-retention controls.

- Maintain SOPs, process narratives, control descriptions, and recurring close checklists.

- Escalate accounting judgments, control exceptions, data limitations, and close risks early and clearly.

- Partner with Finance Systems and process owners to improve NetSuite, spreadsheets, data integrations, reconciliations, and reporting workflows.

- Identify and support practical automation and AI opportunities while maintaining data validation, human review, controls, and auditability.

- Work closely with Sales Operations, Revenue, Payroll, FP&A, Tax, Legal, and other stakeholders to resolve data issues, exceptions, and close dependencies.

- Communicate accounting requirements clearly and drive timely follow-up on inputs, approvals, and open items.

 About you:

- Chartered Accountant, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.

- 1–3 years of experience in accounting, audit, financial reporting, or a related finance role, with exposure to month-end close and reconciliations.

- Working knowledge of US GAAP; exposure to ASC 606, commission accounting, revenue, or cost of revenue is an advantage but not required.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with NetSuite or another ERP and interest in automation or AI are preferred.

- Clear communication, attention to detail, ownership, learning agility, and ability to work effectively across teams.

Location: 

- 

This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)

Compensation & Benefits:

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are a diverse bunch of people, and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-HYBRID

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. About the Role:

Glean is seeking an AI Data Analyst to help power the human evaluation system behind Glean’s AI product quality. This role sits at the centre of response quality, competitive benchmarking, and release readiness. You will evaluate AI outputs, label and categorize failure modes, maintain high-quality benchmark data, and help ensure the datasets and evals we rely on are realistic, consistent, and tied to measurable product quality lift. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work closely with QA, Engineering, Product, and the evals team to convert ambiguous quality issues into structured data, actionable feedback, and repeatable quality signals.

You will: 

- Run ongoing human labeling for priority AI workflows, including response quality, task success, MCP and tool use, end-to-end Cowork-style workflows.

- Triage bad-query reports, downvotes, escalations, and routed quality issues; categorize failure modes and feed clean analysis back to partner teams.

- Perform qualitative analysis to identify recurring patterns such as hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-use issues, weak grounding, and poor workflow completion.

- Follow and improve labeling guidelines and rubrics so judgments are consistent, realistic, and useful for model and product improvement.

- Maintain high-quality labeled datasets, golden sets, and regression slices; monitor coverage, drift, leakage, and difficulty distribution.

- Participate in calibration exercises with human graders and validate LLM-as-a-judge outputs against human labels to improve consistency and judge quality.

- Partner with engineers, PMs, QA, and eval owners on pre/post-change quality reads, benchmark updates, and release-readiness decisions.

- Contribute to recurring quality reporting by surfacing top failure modes, coverage gaps, quality shifts, and actionable recommendations.

About you:

- 3–5 years of experience in data labeling, data analysis, QA, or a related field.

- Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to apply nuanced rubrics consistently.

- Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs or working with NLP, search, recommendation, or other ML systems.

- Familiarity with structured qualitative analysis, basic SQL/data retrieval, and spreadsheet-based workflows.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and collaborate effectively across functions.

Location:

This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our offices).

About the Role:

The bottleneck in building reliable, useful AI is no longer writing code. It's defining what good looks like and measuring how well our products deliver it. That takes high-quality data and evals that teams can trust.

Our team owns data and evaluation science for Glean's AI products. We build evalsets, agentic LLM-judges, and benchmarks that capture what good looks like, along with the platform and infrastructure that run evals reliably at scale, and enterprise simulation environments where we test how our assistants and agents actually perform. Starting from real production usage, you'll turn what we learn into evals that guide improvements across the entire stack, from agent harnesses to tool use, skill iteration, model routing, and post-training of task specific models.

You'll bring new research into production and partner with R&D, product, and GTM to turn findings from evals into better products and customer outcomes. If you care about quality and want to build the systems that measure it, this role is for you.

You will:

- Build evalsets and benchmarks from expert-curated examples, production data, synthetic data, and past failures, covering edge cases and key user slices.

- Build and scale the eval platform and agent observability: experiment pipelines, trace capture and replay, and dashboards, with reproducible, affordable runs.

- Build agentic LLM verifiers for correctness, groundedness, citation quality, and task success, and calibrate them against human labels using clear rubrics.

- Run evals at every stage, from CI and pre-release suites to sampled production traffic, and report results with confidence intervals.

- Build enterprise simulation environments with simulated users and realistic company data to test multi-step agent tasks.

- Diagnose failures by slice and trace, and turn eval results into concrete fixes, weighing quality against latency and cost.

About you:

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with strong Go and/or Python and backend fundamentals: APIs, data modeling, testing, and distributed pipelines. TypeScript is a plus.

- Experience building datasets and benchmarks for LLM use-cases, RAG, or agents, including evalset curation and synthetic data generation.

- Familiarity with eval methodologies and their tradeoffs: deterministic metrics, LLM-as-a-judge, pointwise vs pairwise grading, human labeling, and judge calibration.

- Experience building eval or experiment infrastructure that runs reliably at scale, including CI/CD integrations and observability tooling like OpenTelemetry.

- Strong analytical skills: you dig into traces and failure cases, write SQL, and use data and metrics to explain why quality moved.

- Nice to have: experience with simulation environments and/or model post-training techniques.

Location:

- This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office)

Compensation & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

About the Role

Glean is seeking a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead security for Glean as a company and for our core product. Reporting to the CTO, you will set the strategy and operating model across product and platform security, corporate security, detection and response, risk, and compliance, turning that strategy into measurable risk reduction.

This is an executive role for a leader who combines technical judgment with strong organizational leadership. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, IT, and company leadership to make sound security decisions at the pace of an AI company. You should be able to go deep on architecture and incidents, build a durable program, and communicate clearly about risk and trade-offs.

- Set a risk-based security strategy, priorities, policies, metrics, and decision-making mechanisms that scale with Glean’s business. Give executives a clear view of material risks, remediation progress, and decisions that require business ownership, with a clear operating cadence to ensure risks are visible, owned, prioritized, and reduced.

- Partner with Engineering and Product to build security into architecture, design, development, release, and operations. Guide security across application and platform layers, identity and authorization, customer-data flows, cloud environments, integrations, and AI-enabled capabilities, including models, agents, and the tools and data they can access.

- Lead a measurable vulnerability-management and secure-development program spanning threat modeling, code and dependency risk, software supply-chain security, penetration testing, bug bounty, remediation ownership, and validation. Use automation and AI-assisted analysis thoughtfully to increase coverage and shorten time to fix.

- Oversee security for corporate systems, identity, endpoints, SaaS applications, cloud infrastructure, and privileged access. Partner with IT and technical owners to improve preventive controls, monitoring, and operational resilience.

- Ensure the organization can detect, assess, contain, recover from, and learn from security incidents. Clarify escalation and decision paths; coordinate with Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Communications, and business leaders; and ensure corrective actions are completed and validated.

- Own security risk management, compliance strategy, audit readiness, and control effectiveness. Support frameworks and customer or regulatory requirements relevant to Glean’s business, which may include SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, and FedRAMP. Track meaningful outcomes in risk reduction, vulnerability remediation, incident readiness, and control effectiveness.

- Build and grow a high-performing team across security engineering, enterprise security, detection and response, and governance. Set clear ownership, develop technical and people leaders, and create an environment where teams can execute with focus and accountability.

- Build strong working relationships across the company, helping teams understand practical safeguards and make informed risk decisions without unnecessary friction. Partner with customer-facing security leaders on escalations and assurance needs. Contribute security expertise to commercial security products in partnership with their Product and business owners; those teams retain ownership of their product roadmaps.

About you

- Senior security leadership experience with accountability for a broad, enterprise-scale security program at a high-growth technology or product company. Experience as a CISO, deputy CISO, or senior security executive is strongly preferred.

- Strong technical depth across product and application security, cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management, secure development, and vulnerability management. You can engage credibly with senior engineers on architecture and remediation choices.

- Experience building and operating effective security, detection, and incident-response programs, including leading through high-severity incidents and ensuring lessons result in durable improvements.

- Practical expertise in security risk management, governance, compliance, and audit readiness, with the judgment to distinguish control completion from actual risk reduction.

- A track record of partnering with Product and Engineering to ship secure products and embed security in fast-moving development organizations.

- Experience building, leading, and retaining strong multidisciplinary teams; setting priorities; allocating resources; and creating clear accountability across teams.

- Excellent executive communication and judgment. You can explain technical issues and uncertainty plainly, recommend a path forward, and escalate material risk at the right time. You bring a collaborative, pragmatic leadership style that earns trust while holding a high bar for security outcomes.

About the role

Glean is looking for a Content Systems Engineer to own the documentation experience for our connectors—the integrations that allow Glean to securely access knowledge across our customers’ systems.

Connector documentation serves technical administrators responsible for configuring access, authentication, permissions, and deployments within their organizations. Keeping this information complete and accurate across a rapidly evolving product requires more than traditional authoring. It requires scalable systems that can detect change, generate and validate content, surface risk, and prevent documentation from drifting away from the product.

In this role, you will combine technical-writing expertise with programming, information architecture, and advanced AI practices. You will build deterministic automation and agentic workflows that improve documentation freshness and accuracy while reducing repetitive manual work. You will remain accountable for the quality of the resulting customer experience—not merely for producing content.

This is an AI-first documentation role. You will use AI to analyse complex inputs, generate and transform content, identify gaps, and support maintenance at scale. You will provide the judgment, technical understanding, evaluation systems, and guardrails needed to ensure that those systems produce accurate, useful, and trustworthy results.

The systems and practices you establish for connector documentation will also help improve quality across Glean’s broader documentation set.

You will:

- Own the end-to-end quality, organization, and maintenance of Glean’s connector documentation.

- Develop a deep understanding of how Glean’s connectors work, including their configuration, authentication, permissions, deployment, and troubleshooting requirements.

- Build and maintain scripts, agents, and content pipelines that automate documentation creation, transformation, validation, and maintenance.

- Design reusable AI workflows that combine appropriate models, tools, product context, instructions, and human review.

- Create evaluations and guardrails for AI-generated and AI-maintained documentation, investigate failures, and improve the context, tools, prompts, and systems that shape output quality.

- Build deterministic checks that detect stale, inconsistent, incomplete, or inaccurate documentation.

- Establish an information architecture that helps technical administrators navigate complex setup and configuration flows.

- Partner with Engineering, Product, QA, Support, field teams, and customers to understand product behavior, identify documentation risks, and prioritize improvements.

- Define and track measures of documentation health, including freshness, accuracy, automated-check coverage, manual effort, and field or support complaints.

- Apply successful tools, standards, and quality systems from the connector domain to the broader Glean documentation practice.

About you:

- Prior professional experience of 8-10 Years creating or maintaining technical documentation for a complex software product.

- A bachelor’s degree in computer science, technical communication, engineering, or another relevant field.

- Demonstrated ability to independently build, debug, test, and maintain useful scripts, agents, automations, or content pipelines.

- Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, preferably Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript.

- Experience with docs-as-code or software-development workflows, including Git, GitHub, command-line tools, code review, and CI/CD.

- Advanced practical experience using AI beyond one-off content generation, such as:

- Strong knowledge of technical-writing and content-design principles, including audience analysis, information architecture, task-oriented documentation, and progressive disclosure.

- The judgment to organize large amounts of ambiguous or conflicting information without producing unverified or low-quality content.

- The ability to learn a technically complex product deeply and explain how it works with authority.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product managers, QA, support teams, field teams, and other subject-matter experts.

- A customer-focused approach to evaluating documentation quality and prioritizing improvements.

- Strong interviewing and writing skills; able to turn raw inputs into clear, outcome‑driven narratives.

- Confident, concise communicator with internal and customer stakeholders.

- Experience running a customer reference desk or champion community and coordinating speakers, executive programs, webinars, conferences, or multi-city events.

- Experience producing case studies, customer videos, social content, or review campaigns and working with creative or event vendors, rewards, gifting, budgets, permissions, releases, logo rights, and communications or legal approvals.

About the Role:

Glean is looking for a talented Designated Technical Support Engineer to join our rapidly expanding, venture-backed startup. We are building a modern knowledge assistant personalized to every employee in your organization, making all information within your company accessible, contextual, and fresh. Our team works hard and plays hard. We are professional, creative, passionate, and most importantly - customer-obsessed.

As a trusted technical resource to the customer, you will provide both proactive and reactive support to our growing customer base. By providing the highest level of service to our customers, you will ensure our customer experience is the best in the industry.

You will:

- Own the proactive and reactive support for Glean customers by prioritizing issues for your designated customer(s)

- Meet with your assigned customers regularly to review issues and develop resolution plans and drive continuous improvement in how you and your Glean teammates provide support to them

- Be available to your assigned customers via collaborative communication channels consistently to ensure you are providing timely responses and updates on issues

- Create and maintain customer-specific runbooks and knowledge articles

- Provide first response, technical troubleshooting, resolution, and follow-through of customer issues and inquiries

- Assist customers in the configuration, set-up, and verification of new content sources and product features to enable them to realize additional value for their users

- Educate customers on the use of Glean product features

- Identify system and user health issues, then create and execute remediation plans while coordinating and updating the customer accordingly

- Handle customer-impacting alerts which require coordination with customer admin and system resources through resolution

- Work closely with teams across Glean to drive product, process, and service improvements

- Drive key improvement projects that will improve the scale and efficiency of support, while providing upgrades to the customers’ support experience

- Coordinate all support activities with your assigned customer(s), which may include more stringent access and security processes, ensuring you move with high urgency for their issues.

- Represent the unique needs of your assigned customer(s) with respect to product and security improvements that will improve the customer support experience

- Please note that this role will be dedicated to select customers and requires additional background screenings/clearances/training/certification, carry & use of customer-provided equipment, and extended on-call shift timing based on customer contractual obligations.

About you:

- Technically curious: you have a never-ending desire to add technical knowledge and skills to your personal toolkit and share those learnings with your peers

- Fearless: you have an intense need to tackle the toughest customer issues and technically complex issues with the goal of driving customer satisfaction

- Strong communicator: you are a professional presenter with superior interaction skills with both customers and internal teams

- Detail-oriented: you are highly organized and methodical, ensuring all issues are managed to completion

- Data-driven: you utilize metrics and objective measurements to assess success and improvement opportunities for yourself and for the customer experience

- Key knowledge and skills required:

- Must-haves:

- Problem solving: technical problem-solving skills including the ability to troubleshoot and isolate issues to their root cause

- Ability to debug issues including searching & reading application logs, analyzing stack traces and browser trace files

- Experience in at least one of the following disciplines: Customer Solutions Engineering, Support Engineering, Professional Services

- Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: Search technologies, Knowledge technologies, SaaS-based system integrations

- Experience with Cloud technologies in at least one of the following: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure

- Must have experience in troubleshooting REST API issues

- Working experience on SSO, SAML, and OAuth along with network troubleshooting

- Able to fully document issues you manage and contribute to the support knowledge base

- Good-to-haves:

- Knowledge of SQL/database, Basic Kubernetes, Intermediate/Advanced Linux

- Experience in using Github, Jira & Confluence

- Basic knowledge of LLM’s and how GPT works

Location:

- 

This role is hybrid (3 days a week in Nashville, TN).

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard base salary range for this position is $125,000 - $164,000 USD annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. About the Role:

Glean is seeking an experienced and consultative Enterprise Account Executive to drive new logo acquisition and expansion in our San Francisco office. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from pipeline generation through close—navigating complex, multi-stakeholder deals with C-level executives, partnering closely with Sales Engineering, and building clear ROI and business cases that accelerate adoption of Glean’s Work AI platform.

You will:

- Source and close net new logos within a given territory

- Have the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and identify executive sponsors and champions

- Research and understand the business objectives of your customers and have the ability to perform a value drive sales cycle

- Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success 

- You will consistently deliver ARR revenue targets and drive success through a metric based approach

- Develop and execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings

- Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions

- Create ROI and business justification reports based off of a data driven approach

- Run tight POCs based off of business success criteria

About you:

- 6+ years of closing experience in Sales with a track record of being a top performer

- Ability to learn, pitch and demonstrate a highly technical product and have the ability to adapt in a fast growing and changing environment 

- Have clear examples of closing complex deals and selling into complex organizations

- Effectively use a repeatable method for uncovering greenfield opportunities and building out a new territory 

- Previous experience building relationships and selling face to face to C level executives

About the Role:

Your job is to discover and build Glean's next generation of product surfaces, working in a pod with Forward Deployed PMs directly with the C-suite of the world's most influential companies and with Glean's own engineering and product teams.

Glean is a fully horizontal AI platform - and that scope is what makes this role unique. You won't be configuring existing products or optimizing within defined constraints. You'll identify the biggest unsolved business problems at our most strategic customers, build entirely new products to solve them, and in doing so shape what Glean becomes. The best of what you build ships to every Glean customer in the world. You get founder-level ownership with Glean's resources, relationships, and scale behind you.

- Discover and build Glean's next product surfaces: Your primary job is 0-to-1 product creation. What you build becomes what Glean ships.

- Lead deep opportunity discovery: Before you write a line of code, you go deep on the business. What's structurally broken? Where is the biggest concentration of unsolved value? What's actually buildable, and what's the fastest path to something real that can be tested and learned from? You'll form strong hypotheses alongside your FDPM and pressure-test them directly with the people who have to live with the outcome.

- Be a technical partner to the C-suite: You'll earn trust at the highest levels of your customer organizations - not just with technical teams, but with the executives who are accountable for outcomes. You can explain what you're building, why it will work, and what the risks are to anyone in the room.

- Scale what works Once something works, you'll make it repeatable - working closely with the core R&D team to ensure the product is scalable

- Stay at the frontier with Glean's R&D team: You'll work closely with Glean's core engineering and product teams, staying ahead of what's possible on the platform and actively shaping how its capabilities evolve. What you encounter in the field directly informs what gets built next.

- You think like a founder. When you walk into a customer, you're curious about the business, digging into what's broken, and figuring out what to build that doesn't yet exist. You've shipped actual products that real people use, that drove real outcomes - and you want to do it at a higher level of ambition.

- 0-to-1 build track record: You've built production software from scratch in ambiguous environments. You can point to something that didn't exist before you showed up and is now used by real people at scale.

- Production AI experience: You've shipped AI-powered solutions in the real world - prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, deployment at scale. Not just prototypes.

- Full-stack technical depth: Strong programming skills across the stack with a deep understanding of and experience with how enterprise systems actually work.

- Business acumen: You can walk into a customer, identify where the real problems are, and connect that diagnosis to a product hypothesis - without being handed a brief.

- Customer instinct: You build trust quickly at every level of an organization, communicate with clarity, and know how to tailor your depth to the room.

- Builder's judgment: You know what's actually buildable, how long it will take, and when to simplify scope to get something real into production faster. You spot problems early and solve them independently.

- Curiosity and scrappiness: You're driven to understand problems deeply before solving them, and resourceful enough to find a path forward when none is obvious.

- Experience: 4+ years in technical roles with a track record of shipping production software. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply.

- Experience as a founder, at a top-tier technology company, or in a forward deployed engineering role.

- Conduct architecture reviews, technical design reviews, and code reviews.

- Define and enforce Salesforce engineering standards and best practices across coding, testing, security, documentation, version control, and release management.

- Mentor Salesforce developers and administrators and provide technical guidance on complex technical problems.

- Define and maintain Salesforce environment and sandbox strategies and support CI/CD and automated deployment practices.

- Lead Salesforce deployment planning, validation, rollback planning, and production readiness reviews.

- Establish appropriate unit, integration, regression, and deployment validation testing practices.

- Investigate complex Salesforce defects, integration failures, data issues, performance problems, and security concerns.

- Lead root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement durable solutions to recurring issues.

- Develop and maintain operational runbooks, troubleshooting documentation, and technical documentation.

- Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Marketing, Partnerships, IT, Security, and other business teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Provide technical input into roadmap planning, prioritization, vendor evaluations, and platform governance.

- Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve user experience, increase automation, and maximize the value of Salesforce.

- Contribute to the long-term architecture and technical strategy of Glean's revenue systems ecosystem.

About you:

- 7–10+ years of Salesforce development experience, including significant experience with enterprise Salesforce implementations.

- Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, SOQL, SOSL, and Salesforce APIs.

- Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, including data modeling, object relationships, security and sharing, profiles, permission sets, access controls, automation, governor limits, performance optimization, and deployment architecture.

- Proven experience designing and troubleshooting REST and SOAP integrations.

- Experience working with middleware or integration platforms and enterprise application integrations.

- Strong understanding of integration patterns, error handling, retries, monitoring, observability, and data synchronization.

- Experience with Git and structured CI/CD or Salesforce release-management practices.

- Experience writing and maintaining automated tests and deployment validation processes.

- Experience leading technical design, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering standards.

- Strong production support, debugging, incident management, and root-cause analysis experience.

- Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and influence technical decisions.

- Strong stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
About the Role:

Glean is seeking a Partner Sales Manager to build and manage strategic partners to expand Glean’s customer reach in Europe. This individual will be closely aligned to multiple sales segment teams and be responsible for building and executing the partner strategy to drive meaningful revenue impact—in a hands-on, results-oriented role.

You will: 

- Build and maintain executive and working-level relationships across key partnerships and the Glean sales teams that translate into measurable sourced and influenced pipeline growth

- Educate and coach the Glean Sales teams on the “why” and the “how” of scaling with our revenue growth with partners

- Define and operationalize co-selling and co-delivery motions that are aligned with Glean’s field priorities and designed to scale with the right partners.

- Build repeatable plays for sourcing new opportunities, including campaigns, events, account mapping, and outbound motions, and maintain clear visibility into partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.

- Work cross-functionally with Sales, SE, Marketing, Operations, and Legal to simplify and scale partner processes such as deal registration, approvals, contracts, MDF and reporting.

- Embed with the sales organization by aligning partners to territories, participating in key deal reviews and account planning, and ensuring partners feel like an extension of the Glean field teams.

About you:

- Outcome- and revenue-oriented partner leader who thinks like a GM/business owner, not just a relationship manager, and is comfortable being accountable for partner-driven pipeline and bookings.

- 5-8 years experience in channel, alliances, partner management, or business development roles in B2B SaaS.

- Background in search, AI, productivity, or enterprise SaaS is required. With at least 1-2 years of experience in frontier AI sales, having worked on and delivered projects — either directly with customers or via partners — implementing AI solutions.

- Demonstrated success recruiting, activating, and growing SI/VAR or similar partners, not just managing inherited relationships.

- Strong collaborator with sales, with experience working in tight lockstep with regional leaders and field reps to align partners to territories, accounts, and plays.

- Excellent communicator and influencer, comfortable presenting to executives, negotiating with partner leaders, and coaching partner sellers and SEs.

- Familiarity with modern sales and partner tooling, including CRM, PRM, and reporting/BI tools, and comfort navigating evolving tech stacks.

- Able to travel periodically to partners, key accounts, and internal events, including SKOs and GKOs, as needed.

- Experience operating across multiple European markets, comfortable navigating different languages, business cultures, and regulatory environments to expand partner coverage.

Nice to have:

- German language proficiency to support partnerships and account coverage across DACH markets.

Location:

- This role is hybrid (Minimum 1 day per week in office)

- Based in Amsterdam or London

Compensation & Benefits:

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset at Glean:

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

About the Role:

At Glean, partners are force multipliers. As a Partner Solutions Engineer, you will be a partner-facing technical expert responsible for helping strategic partners across VARs, GSIs, SIs, Cloud Partners, and ISVs, successfully design, deploy, scale, and operationalize Glean across their customer base. This role is designed for someone comfortable leading hands-on workshops and enablement sessions, developing technical solutions, and consulting on complex partner-led services. You will work directly with partner solution architects, delivery teams, product teams, and partner managers to help them build the skills, assets, offerings, and confidence required to establish a durable Glean services practice. Rather than focusing on isolated enablements or individual deals, you will enable partners to support many customers at scale. From that foundation, you will guide partners in delivering post-sales services and production-ready Glean solutions.

You will:

- Own the technical success of partners across onboarding, deep technical enablement, early production deployments, and scaled delivery motions.

- Lead hands-on technical trainings, deep dives, workshops, and co-build sessions for partner engineers, architects, consultants, and delivery teams.

- Help partners create repeatable service offerings, implementation packages, and reference architectures on top of Glean.

- Develop partner technical maturity over time so their teams can independently architect, implement, troubleshoot, and support Glean in production.

- Identify gaps in partner capability and work with Partner Managers, Product, Engineering, and Solutions teams to close them through programs, code, content, or product changes.

- Act as Glean’s technical representative within partner organizations, building strong relationships with partner technical leaders and helping them succeed with shared customers.

- Provide technical support and expertise for partner-led services and solutions, consulting when complexity is highest, especially around agent development, custom connectors, custom integrations, and platform extensibility best practices.

- Co-build reusable demos and workshops for partner-led solutions involving Glean Agents, Actions, APIs, Web SDK / embedded experiences, custom connectors, and broader extensibility patterns.

- Build prototypes, reference implementations, samples repos, services patterns, and reusable content that help partners move from concept to working deployment faster.

- Bring a strong bias toward execution and technical craftsmanship: this role should produce working outcomes, not just slideware or strategy recommendations.

- Capture field learnings from partner deployments and translate them into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering teams.

- Codify winning patterns into reusable assets such as implementation guides, architecture blueprints, code samples, workshops, and troubleshooting playbooks.

- Help define the next generation of partner competencies and services motions.

- Scale the function by turning bespoke field work into repeatable partner-facing and internal best practices.

About you:

Required

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 5+ years of experience in a technical role such as: partner engineer, forward-deployed engineer, solutions architect, solutions engineer, consulting/professional services, or other related technical role.

- Experience building or deploying AI / LLM / agent-based systems in production.

- Experience writing, debugging, integrating, and deploying production software systems using APIs, SDKs, auth patterns, and cloud services.

- Strong engineering fundamentals plus hands-on coding experience in Python and at least one of TypeScript / JavaScript / Java.

- Understanding of cloud platforms, with practical experience on at least one major provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure).

- Proven ability to lead technical workshops, deep dives, or hands-on enablement that results in durable partner capability.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, from engineering teams to executives.

- High tolerance for ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and broad context-switching across technical and non-technical problems.

- Willingness to travel 25% - 50%.

Preferred

- 8+ years in a technical role.

- Experience working with VARs, GSIs, SIs, Cloud Partners, ISVs, or partner delivery organizations.

- Experience with custom data source connectors, indexing pipelines, embedded experiences, enterprise search / retrieval, knowledge systems, or workflow automation.

- Experience creating reusable technical assets such as tutorials, guides, workshops, code labs, reference architectures, and implementation playbooks.

- Experience shaping roadmap or packaging decisions from partner or customer deployment feedback.

- Prior experience in a startup or high-growth environment where you’ve shaped new partner motions, integrations, or GTM plays.

Success in this role

- Partners can independently deliver production-grade Glean services and solutions in addition to technical demos and pre-sales support.

- Partners develop a visible Glean technical practice with trained engineers, repeatable offerings, reference architectures, and delivery confidence.

- There is a growing catalog of reusable accelerators, code artifacts, workshops, solution packages, and implementation guides that make partner-led delivery faster and more consistent.

- Partner-led deployments see faster time to value because hard technical blockers are solved in pre-sales or early post-sales and with more rigor.

- Glean’s Product and Engineering teams receive high-signal feedback from real partner deployments that improve platform readiness and capability.

Location:

This role is hybrid based out of San Francisco, CA with 3 days per week in office with 25-50% travel for partner-facing work.

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $250,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. - Strong communication and collaboration skills

- Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team

- Passion for security and a commitment to building secure and reliable systems

Key knowledge and skills

- Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-nit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must.

- A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features.

- An interest/desire to learn and own various aspects of security.

- Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc) with an emphasis on designing for reliability and scale, and writing well-tested components.

- Experience with cloud security principles and tools (AWS Security, GCP Security)

- Experience with container security (Docker Security, Kubernetes Security)

About the Role:

Glean is looking for a Principal Product Marketing Manager, Glean Enterprise Context to define and execute the go-to-market strategy for the technologies that power reliable, enterprise-grade AI. Enterprise AI is at its root the intersection of AI and enterprise data and you will shape telling this story in the market. This role will translate advances in context, connectors, indexes, Enterprise Graphs, semantic layers, ontologies, into clear product narratives, differentiated market positioning, and practical resources that help customers understand Glean Enterprise Context.

You will work at the intersection of product, engineering, research, sales, and communications. You will stay close to the rapidly evolving data and AI landscape, develop a strong point of view on where the market is going, and bring Glean’s technical advantages to life through launches, customer communications, thought leadership, technical collateral, and field enablement.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a product marketer who can engage deeply with technical teams, understand how modern data systems work, and communicate complex ideas with precision and impact. You will help establish Glean as a technical leader in the next generation of enterprise AI.

You will: 

- Own the product marketing strategy and go-to-market plans for Glean Enterprise Context, including new connectors, search quality, Enterprise Graph, structured data, memory, and the context that provides high-quality AI experiences.

- Partner with Product and Engineering to translate architecture, technical tradeoffs, roadmap priorities, and customer value into differentiated positioning, messaging, launch plans, and customer-ready narratives.

- Lead end-to-end launches for platform capabilities—from audience and release strategy through communications, technical documentation, field enablement, customer education, and post-launch adoption—while establishing repeatable launch processes.

- Define Glean’s point of view on the emerging new context stack for AI; create compelling technical content and customer stories that show how teams can measure, improve, and trust AI applications and agents.

- Represent Glean Enterprise Context as a technical spokesperson; and equip Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partners with the proof points and architecture they need to drive adoption.

About you: 

- 8+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, or related field

- BA/BS in business, marketing, liberal arts, or related degree

- Bring significant experience in data platforms, AI systems, or a related technical category

- Understand modern AI data systems deeply, including RAG, indexing, knowledge graphs, semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise data architectures

- Closely follow the AI industry and bring technical credibility with Product, Engineering, Research, developers, and technical buyers, translating complex technical decisions and market developments into clear customer and business implications.

- Are an exceptional technical storyteller and writer who can turn architecture, evaluation results, and product capabilities into compelling narratives and collateral without oversimplifying the technology.

- Have a track record of bringing complex technical products to market, communicating effectively with audiences ranging from developers to executives, and influencing cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Communications, and Brand.

- Are rigorous about accuracy and evidence, energized by ambiguity, and able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution; a technical bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred, and an MBA is a plus.

Location: 

- This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office OR San Francisco office)

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard base salary range for this position is $224,000 - $258,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

- Agent harness: experience designing or shipping the execution layer around the model, including planning, tool calling, context management, sub-agents, skills, memory, and long-running tasks, and making the tradeoffs across intelligence, latency, and cost that determine how well agents perform.

- Evaluation: experience building the evalsets, benchmarks, judges, and labeled data that gate launches, compare models and harness changes, and drive continuous hill-climbing on quality.

This is a highly technical, cross-functional IC role. You will work closely with AI engineering, data science, and platform marketing teams, and you will partner with leading model providers and help go-to-market teams turn quality improvements into customer proof points.

You will:

- Set the product strategy and roadmap for your area, grounded in customer workflows, trace data, and eval results.

- Define what "good" looks like for agentic work, including correctness, helpfulness, formatting, efficiency, and reliability, and turn it into clear, measurable launch bars.

- Make evidence-based tradeoffs across models, prompts, tools, and harness changes, balancing quality against latency, cost, and capacity.

- Decide when to use frontier models versus post-training open-weight models for specific tasks, weighing quality, cost, latency, and control, and define the data and evals needed to make post-trained models competitive.

- Build and scale the operating model for evaluation, including datasets, LLM-as-judge systems, human labeling, and benchmarks.

- Turn failed runs, poor traces, and user feedback into prioritized product and quality improvements.

- Partner with model providers and strategic partners on model evaluation, launches, and joint quality work.

- Give the team context, set direction, and build alignment across engineering, data science, and GTM teams without direct authority.

About you:

- You have 4+ years of product management experience, ideally on AI/ML, developer-platform, infrastructure, or quality-tooling products serving large enterprises.

- You have built or worked closely on LLM-powered agents or at-scale AI products, and you understand how harness design choices affect agent behavior.

- You are fluent in LLM evaluation concepts: evalsets, LLM-as-judge, pairwise/side-by-side judging, judge calibration against human labels, benchmarks, and offline-versus-online alignment.

- You are comfortable going deep on agentic systems, including multi-turn tasks, tool use, context and memory management, write actions, and tracing and observability.

- You are rigorous with data and can turn ambiguous quality problems into crisp hypotheses, metrics, and experiments.

- You have a strong technical background and can engage credibly with engineers and data scientists on system design and experiment results.

- You are an excellent written and verbal communicator who enjoys engaging with GTM teams and customers, and you can bridge our technical choices with the outcomes our customers care about.

- You have a proven track record of taking ownership, taking initiative, and delivering results.

- You have a learning and growth mindset, and you are mission-first.

- You are an early adopter of AI in your own product craft, and you use coding agents and AI tools to prototype, analyze, and move faster.

- This role is hybrid (4 days a week in one of our SF Bay Area offices)

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a talented Resident Solutions Architect to join our rapidly expanding, venture-backed startup. In this role, you will serve as the strategic technical advisor for a small set of Glean’s most important Enterprise and Strategic customers, where architecture, integration, governance, and production-readiness demands are high. You will act as the named technical owner for each account, guiding long-term architecture decisions, shaping advanced workflows into production, and aligning technical plans to measurable customer outcomes. This is the strategic technical layer in the engagement team - not a reactive support role or generic project coordination role.

You will:

- 

Serve as the primary strategic technical advisor and point of contact for assigned customers, operating as the technical counterpart to the customer relationship.

- 

Own the technical account strategy for assigned customers, including quarterly technical roadmap reviews, technical operating reviews, and executive technical alignment.

- 

Develop and maintain strategic technical roadmaps aligned to customer business objectives, implementation milestones, and measurable technical success criteria.

- 

Lead technical decision-making and architecture review workshops, documenting recommendations, trade-offs, supported patterns, and ownership.

- 

Guide customers through architecture, design, and implementation choices across connectors, MCP, actions, APIs, SDKs, custom UI embeds, and agent workflows.

- 

Productionize advanced customer workflows by defining evals, governance, observability, guardrails, and production-readiness requirements before broad rollout.

- 

Design and deliver, or lead the design and delivery of, strategic technical builds such as Skills, Actions, MCP servers, custom connectors, Web SDK integrations, Client API integrations, and embedded experiences.

- 

Partner with Solutions Architects as the execution layer when scoped implementation work should be delegated, while remaining accountable for the overall technical direction and customer outcomes.

- 

Provide technical enablement to customer admins, developers, and technical stakeholders so they can operate, extend, and support Glean effectively in their environment.

- 

Align technical plans with Customer Success, AI Outcomes Managers, Account teams, Product, Engineering, and Support so the customer has one coherent technical narrative.

- 

Translate recurring customer friction, deployment blockers, and enterprise requirements into engineering-ready product feedback with clear business impact and technical context.

- 

Serve as a recognized advisor to executives, Product, and R&D on enterprise customer reality, solution design, and platform trade-offs for high-value customer motions.

- 

Support customer governance and security motions, including reviews tied to identity, networking, data protection, observability, and enterprise rollout readiness.

- 

Act as a steady technical point of contact for strategic customer initiatives, helping frame escalations correctly while keeping break/fix ownership with Support and other operational teams.

- 

Own cross-account technical programs and reusable blueprints that improve how Glean delivers post-sales outcomes across customers.

- 

Define and improve the RSA operating model, service packaging, and repeatable delivery patterns so strategic work scales cleanly across customers and teams.

- 

Contribute to the Glean customer technical community by codifying repeatable patterns, playbooks, and artifacts for strategic accounts.

- 

Shape the SA organization through mentorship, advanced enablement programs, and reusable guidance that raises the bar for strategic technical consulting.

About you:

- 

You are a clear communicator who can lead technical conversations with architects, admins, developers, security stakeholders, and executives.

- 

You are strategic and analytical, with the ability to connect roadmap, architecture, governance, and production outcomes into a clear technical point of view, while evaluating trade-offs in ambiguous environments.

- 

You are customer-minded, organized, builder-oriented, and accountable, with a track record of building trust, maintaining momentum, and owning technical outcomes even when execution is shared across teams.

- 

You have software development experience in at least two of the following: Python, Java, Go, or similarly relevant modern programming languages.

- 

You have strong experience with APIs, SDKs, custom data integrations, and enterprise application architecture in hybrid, SaaS, or on-prem environments.

- 

You have strong AI fluency that goes beyond basic prompting, including integrating AI into core workflows, building repeatable multi-step processes, and applying the right mix of agents, coding tools, and workflow automation.

- 

You have the ability to shape technical patterns across Skills, agent workflows, MCP, custom actions, custom connectors, Web SDK, Client APIs, and embedded product experiences.

- 

You have hands-on experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot responsibly to scaffold, refine, test, and debug technical solutions, while retaining ownership of architecture and implementation trade-offs.

- 

You can architect end-to-end AI application patterns on Glean, including content ingestion, retrieval, grounded answer generation, and source-aware response design using APIs such as Indexing, Search, and Chat.

- 

You have strong technical debugging skills, including log analysis, code analysis, end-to-end tracing, and structured troubleshooting across distributed systems.

- 

You bring deep understanding of networking, including cloud and on-prem networking, private connectivity patterns, and enterprise security constraints.

- 

You have hands-on experience with cloud technologies in at least one of the following: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure.

- 

You have security and audit fluency, with the ability to represent product architecture and controls with customer security, privacy, and audit stakeholders.

- 

You have experience defining production-readiness requirements for AI-powered workflows, including evals, observability, governance, reliability, and rollback or escalation paths.

- 

You can evolve prototypes into enterprise-ready designs by addressing permissions, observability, rollout controls, scaling, security, and live debugging in real customer environments.

-

Glean is seeking a Senior Manager, Technical Accounting to lead complex accounting analysis, policy implementation, and controls across finance processes and systems. - Strengthen business-process and system controls across key accounting areas, working with Finance Systems and IT to embed approvals, access controls, data validations, segregation of duties, and exception reporting.

- Establish sustainable control ownership, monitoring, evidence retention, remediation tracking, and reporting to Finance leadership, using automation and AI where appropriate and auditable.

- Define and execute a phased roadmap for building an in-house Internal Audit and Controls function while retaining consultants for specialist and independent support.

- Serve as a trusted accounting advisor to senior Finance and cross-functional leaders, driving alignment when priorities or interpretations differ.

- Establish clear governance, decision rights, operating rhythms, and accountability for technical accounting and controls initiatives.

- Coach and develop team members, raising the quality of accounting analysis, documentation, control ownership, and execution.

- Communicate risks, decisions, dependencies, and recommendations succinctly to Finance leadership.

- Strong working knowledge of US GAAP; practical exposure to IFRS and multi-entity accounting is preferred.

- Experience implementing controls in a multi-entity, multi-system environment.

- Solve hard problems in ordering, idempotency, exactly-once processing, backpressure, and retries across distributed queues, workers, and storage.

- Preserve fine-grained ACLs, deletions, and sensitivity constraints so AI answers are always grounded in what users are actually allowed to see.

- Partner closely with Search Serving, Product, Platforms, and Security teams to define how enterprise context is exposed to LLMs and agents.

- Continuously improve observability, alerting, and automation to onboard larger customers and more data sources with confidence.

- Hands-on experience with distributed systems, data pipelines, queues, and large-scale storage (SQL/NoSQL).

- Design admin-controlled data protection (downloads, sharing, copy/paste, screenshots) with Security and Admin teams, and emit reliable audit events for customer security tooling.

About the Role:

The bottleneck in building reliable and useful AI systems isn’t writing code anymore. It’s knowing what good looks like, applying that knowledge and experience from production usage into building rigorous evals, and using those evals to guide continuous product self-improvement loops.

As the Tech Lead Manager of AI Evaluations, you will lead a team of applied AI scientists and engineers and build the evaluation strategy and platform that helps Glean ship delightful and reliable AI experiences. You will make evaluation a continuous part of how we develop and operate models, harnesses, assistants, agents, and other AI products at Glean.

You’ll guide the team in translating emerging AI/ML research into reliable evaluation systems, build scalable, efficient and reusable eval infrastructure and trusted quality signals, and work across R&D, product, and marketing teams to turn evaluation results into better products and customer outcomes.

You will:

- Own the AI evaluation eng roadmap and technical direction end to end: from defining what success means and building the evaluation platform to integrating results into release and product decisions.

- Build scalable, reusable evaluation infrastructure for datasets, experiments, graders, trace capture and replay, result analysis, and dashboards. Make evaluations reproducible, versioned, cost-aware, and easy for product and engineering teams to use.

- Create and maintain representative evaluation sets from expert-curated examples, appropriately governed production signals, synthetic cases, and historical failures. Cover common workflows, edge cases, long-tail requests, adversarial inputs, and important user and domain slices; protect held-out acceptance sets from tuning leakage.

- Define a balanced quality measurement system for AI products, including correctness, groundedness, retrieval and context relevance, completeness, instruction following, citation quality, user preference, and task success. For agents, evaluate tool selection and arguments, multi-step trajectories, policy compliance, recovery, and final task state, not just the final response.

- Develop a fit-for-purpose mix of deterministic checks, model-based graders (including LLM-based autograders), and human evaluation. Establish clear rubrics; validate and calibrate automated judges against human judgments; and measure evaluator reliability and limitations so teams can trust and interpret scores.

- Integrate evaluation into development and operations: fast CI regression checks, broader pre-release suites, model and prompt comparisons, and sampled production evaluation. Build feedback loops from user feedback and production traces into new test cases, and use monitoring, canaries, and experiments to detect regressions and drift.

- Make quality tradeoffs measurable by connecting evaluation outcomes to latency, reliability, and cost. Help teams diagnose failures by slice and trace, prioritize improvements, and make evidence-based decisions about models, routing, prompts, and system changes.

- Build and lead a high-performing team of applied AI scientists and engineers; coach and develop team members. Partner closely with product, infrastructure, security, and application teams to align evaluation standards and deliver the highest-impact work.

About you:

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, ML infrastructure, data systems, or a related technical field. Experience must include building and operating production systems.

- 5+ years of engineering or applied AI team management experience, with a track record of technical leadership, developing engineers and scientists, and delivering cross-functional projects.

- Hands-on experience designing, building, or operating evaluation systems for LLM/GenAI products, including model-based evaluators or autograders; practical understanding of how to assess model, retrieval/RAG, assistant, or agent behavior.

- Familiarity with evaluation methods and tradeoffs: curated and production-derived datasets, benchmark creation, deterministic metrics, rubric-based and pairwise judgments, human review, judge validation and calibration, human-model alignment, and statistical analysis of results.

- Understanding of agent evaluation, including tool calling, multi-turn behavior, trajectory quality, task completion, and recovery from errors; experience with safety testing or red teaming is a plus.

- Strong coding ability in Python or another production language, with sound engineering fundamentals in testing, APIs, data modeling, and reliable distributed systems.

- Experience building scalable data and developer platforms, experiment pipelines, or CI/CD integrations; familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, data stores, and observability is beneficial.

- Strong judgment about measurement quality, including dataset representativeness, judge calibration, reproducibility, uncertainty, and the risk of optimizing to a narrow metric.

- Knowledge of public benchmarks across domains and capabilities is a plus.

- Product-minded and collaborative: able to translate ambiguous quality goals into clear measures, communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences, and influence roadmaps across teams.

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

- Support recruiter screens, intake preparation, interview debriefs, and offer coordination across the recruiting lifecycle.

- Deliver a consistent candidate experience through clear communication, expectation-setting, timely follow-up, and effective representation of Glean and the role.

- Track pipeline activity, pass-through rates, and process progress; surface risks early and help the team take action.

About you:

- You have approximately 2+ years of recruiting experience, ideally including full-cycle recruiting or direct exposure to technical GTM, customer-facing technical, or adjacent roles.

- You have demonstrated sourcing judgment and can translate a calibrated profile into a focused talent map, outreach plan, and qualified slate.

- You have owned part of the recruiting lifecycle and are ready to manage assigned junior-level searches end to end.

- You are organized, metrics-minded, and disciplined about ATS data, process milestones, and stakeholder follow-through.

- You learn quickly, welcome feedback, and apply structured processes while operating with urgency.

- This role is hybrid, based 4 days a week out of our Mountain View or San Francisco offices.
