About the Role:

Glean is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (Infra LLM TPM) to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that shape how our LLM infrastructure, retrieval, and serving platform evolve, scale, and reliably power our enterprise AI products. This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, ML/LLM engineering, product, and security, ensuring Glean’s AI foundation is robust, performant, and ready to support our most ambitious product bets.

You’ll drive alignment across teams, streamline execution for multi-quarter infra and platform programs, and help deliver highly reliable, cost-efficient, and safe LLM capabilities that advance Glean’s mission. You’ll partner closely with Infra and ML Engineering leaders, Product, and GTM stakeholders to orchestrate end-to-end delivery while ensuring technical excellence, operational rigor, and cross-functional alignment.

You’ll play a central role in:

- Driving the company’s LLM and infra roadmap execution, ensuring alignment between platform strategy, engineering delivery, and product/customer needs.

- Structuring and managing programs for major infra initiatives such as LLM orchestration, retrieval infra, observability and evaluation pipelines, latency/reliability improvements, and cost optimization.

- Anticipating scaling, reliability, and capacity risks, resolving cross-team dependencies, and ensuring smooth execution across infra, product, and GTM teams.

- Improving execution rigor and operational excellence through robust program cadences, postmortems, and continuous improvement of how we build and operate LLM systems.

You will:

- Lead end-to-end technical programs across Glean’s LLM infrastructure and platform, from problem definition and technical design through implementation, rollout, and ongoing operations.

- Drive complex cross-functional initiatives spanning LLM model integrations, retrieval infrastructure, data pipelines, observability, and AI safety.

- Partner with Infrastructure, ML, and Product leaders to define SLOs, capacity plans, and reliability targets, balancing latency, model quality, scalability, and cost.

- Own technical program planning and execution, proactively managing milestones, cross-team dependencies, infrastructure risks, and technical tradeoffs.

- Collaborate with Security, Privacy, and Compliance to ensure LLM infrastructure and data flows meet enterprise-grade safety and governance requirements.

- Establish data-driven mechanisms to monitor infrastructure health and program execution, leveraging metrics such as availability, latency, model evaluations, and cost efficiency.

- Partner with Customer Success and Solutions to understand enterprise customer workloads and inform LLM infrastructure roadmap planning and prioritization.

- Transform traditional program management workflows through AI, data, and automation, building intelligent mechanisms to surface launch-readiness gaps, model and provider risks, capacity constraints, reliability regressions, governance exceptions, and spend anomalies, with clear ownership and actionable next steps.

About you:

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

- 8–10+ years of experience in technical program management or a closely related role, with a proven track record of driving complex infrastructure or platform programs from concept to production in fast-paced SaaS environments..

- Deep technical background in AI/ML systems and LLM infrastructure — e.g., model serving, retrieval systems, evaluation pipelines, or large-scale data/compute platforms — with an ability to translate complex capabilities into practical product and reliability impact.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, data and storage systems, and cloud-native infrastructure (e.g., Kubernetes, observability, CI/CD, security and compliance in enterprise contexts).

- Demonstrated experience structuring multi-quarter infra or platform programs with measurable outcomes across reliability, performance, quality, and cost.

- Demonstrated ability to manage through ambiguity, anticipate scaling and reliability risks early, and build alignment across diverse technical and non-technical teams.

- A builder mindset—proactive, collaborative, detail-oriented, and focused on enabling teams to deliver their best work in a high-velocity environment.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate between deeply technical engineering details, business constraints, and customer impact.

Location:

- This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our San Francisco office)
